name: Kingy AI Price Index
citation: Kingy AI Price Index, September 2025 edition. Kingy AI. https://kingy.ai/ai-price-index/2025-09/

edition.label: September 2025
edition.headline: In September 2025, a million AI tokens cost a median $3.44 from frontier models (down 0.9%), $0.82 from mid-range models (down 2.9%) and $0.26 from small models (no change). A typical AI subscription cost $20.00 a month (no change), and top plans cost $200.00 (no change). Changes compare with August.

story.title: Mid-range model prices fell 2.9% in September
story.text: The median mid-range model cost $0.82 per million tokens, down from $0.85 in August. OpenAI launched a cheaper mid-range model and Mistral AI is now counted.
